unscored_open_calls.item: Count cell on Industry Participant's refusal row (1 or blank)

D1 leaves Count blank on rows about no bidder unit, but E14 says Count is never summed, so the cell does not by itself make Industry Participant an entrant. PE-P03 grades exclusion from live-unit and 'Who was in' figures, not this cell.

unscored_open_calls.item: Spring-2014 Industry Participant talks: a Target interest row or only a mention under Earlier approaches
unscored_open_calls.why: PetSmart was the would-be acquirer ('not for sale'), and E1 excludes a target's attempt to buy another company. But the filing's words 'merger or acquisition' leave some room for the other reading, and the choice changes no counts.

unscored_open_calls.item: Separate Adviser row for the unnamed financial advisor at the 06/18/2014 meeting
unscored_open_calls.why: The filing does not say whether this advisor is J.P. Morgan, which was retained in July after interviews, or another firm. Both treatments are defensible.

unscored_open_calls.item: Whether Buyer Group members were separate signers among the 15 NDAs, which would need a group-formation row before 10/30
unscored_open_calls.why: The filing names the Buyer Group only from its 10/30 indication and never says when it formed. The 24 financial contacts include 'large suppliers of equity capital to lead buyers'. The question cannot be resolved from the filing; PE-P10 therefore does not penalise a flagged pre-10/30 formation.

unscored_open_calls.item: Inferred flag on the nine-non-submitter row
unscored_open_calls.why: The non-submission is reported ('including those that did not submit') and the count of nine is exact arithmetic. The acc9986 review wanted Inferred = Y, while E14's inferred-closure language points both ways.

unscored_open_calls.item: Own row versus Note for events that apply to all bidders alike or have ambiguous materiality: October notice of Longview's willingness to roll over up to 7.5 million shares; the November FY2014 projection update (its presence is scored in PE-C08, not its form); 12/06 merger-agreement comments and Buyer Group financing commitment documents; 12/09 Longview introductory meetings with the Buyer Group and Bidder 2 (Bidder 3 not mentioned)
unscored_open_calls.why: Under E2, access given alike to everyone may go in a Note. The 12/09 meetings may or may not be an information-access difference, since the filing does not say Bidder 3 was excluded. None of these changes counts, rounds or prices.

unscored_open_calls.item: 12/13 board approval of the Buyer Group deal: its own Other material event row or folded into the signing Note
unscored_open_calls.why: E2 folds board review of an offer already recorded into a Note, but the 12/13 approval (subject to open points) is also the selection of the winner. Either treatment is defensible and changes no counts; the Bidder 2 exit date is graded in PE-P09.

unscored_open_calls.item: Round cell of the 12/14 Merger announced row (final round or post)
unscored_open_calls.why: The announcement came on the day of signing. E6 'post' covers events after signing, so either cell is defensible and nothing depends on it.

unscored_open_calls.why: The filing gives no names or counts, and Longview 'did not advocate for any specific transactions' in May. Whether to give this a row is a matter of taste under E2.

notes:
METHOD. This is the reconciled final reference: the drafter's 44 tests checked against three model verifier reports (source fidelity, instruction conformance, coverage). I re-read the frozen v1.13.2 instruction (A-F, E1-E14, D1-D5), the Background of the Merger (pp. 21-27) and the p. 37 projections passage, and settled each disputed point in the filing and the instruction myself. All 45 source_quotes were re-checked by script against the printed-page text of raw_filing/petsmart_2015-02-02_DEFM14A.htm. Each is verbatim under whitespace normalisation, sits on a cited page and is at most 40 words. Weights sum to 30/25/20/10/10/5 = 100 across 45 tests.

Grading rules. accepted_alternatives earn full credit. A three-round map is penalised only in PE-R01, at half credit when its map Question names the two-round reading. PE-R05, R06, R07 and R08 grade consistency with the workbook's own map. The Bidder 3 re-entry model is accepted in PE-P07, P11 and R08. No test grades wording, Note length, the number of Questions or row counts.

Build files: /home/uctpiaj/work/tmp/claude-1001/pe_final/ (build.py, final.json, unscored.json). No repo file was touched.

- Added: PE-C08, the November FY2014 projection update (conformance verifier). E2 names projections revised after bidding began. Because access given alike may sit in a Note, only omission fails. Quote verified on p. 24. The Q3 earnings date is not in the filing.
